purpose: Evaluate whether an official dated Minnesota House Research bill summary existed strictly before a target vote as a zero-weight component of the single quick-evidence-v1 candidate.

source.system: Official Minnesota House Research bill summaries
source.authorityPolicy: dated official House Research summary PDF is authoritative

asOfPolicy.summaryTiming: earliest official summary publication date for that bill
asOfPolicy.reason: summary evidence is date-granular and does not prove ordering within a day

fit.model: single ridge logistic offset on serving Quick logit
selectionMetricOrder: validation chamber mean absolute yes-vote error

descriptivePolicy.emptySliceInterpretation: No 2025-2026 replay events currently have prior House Research summary coverage. The descriptive slice cannot support a stability claim and must not strengthen the diagnostic.

interpretation.positiveSignalMeaning: may justify continued prospective measurement inside quick-evidence-v1 only
